title: A flow reduction for equilibrium uniqueness in rank-one bimatrix games
description: For explicitly listed rational bimatrix games of variable positive dimensions and exact rank(A+B)=1, uniqueness of the entire mixed-strategy equilibrium pair is coNP-complete and NONUNIQUENESS is NP-complete, allowing arbitrary degeneracy. A polynomial reduction from nonempty positive-integer PARTITION produces a known strict pure equilibrium and an additional pair exactly in yes instances. The proof applies the Disser–Skutella signed flow counter and the Adsul/coauthors auxiliary zero-sum representation, with a tailored comparison-preserving perturbation, injective simplex encoding and uniform all-minimizer exact penalty. The support package preserves authored original and fresh review evidence. A bounded primary-source audit found no exact match among inspected bodies; worldwide priority remains unknown.
